name: Sea Hag (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

notes.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Dread Gaze
items.text:
The hag gazes upon a creature, afflicting it with a gnawing sense of impending doom, with a result depending on its DC 20 Will save save. The target doesn't need to be able to see the sea hag.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is frightened 1 and is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Frightened 2 and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

text: Hags are malevolent predators who use magic and manipulation to lure children and young adults into their clutches. They seek out targets who are unhappy, innocent, or otherwise vulnerable, preying on their weaknesses before snatching them up. A sea hag has the upper half of a humanoid and the lower half of an octopus, with translucent skin and glowing lights visible beneath their flesh.
